# Complaints policy: DRAFT for trustee adoption

Status: **DRAFT. Not adopted. Not legal advice.** Trustees should adapt it to their actual capacity and check it against Charity Commission and Fundraising Regulator expectations before adopting.

## 1. Purpose
RallyGood wants to hear when something has gone wrong, whether it concerns a donation, a Drop, a partner, our website, our communications or how we treated someone.

## 2. What counts as a complaint
Any expression of dissatisfaction about RallyGood's activities, fundraising, communications, data handling or people acting for us. Safeguarding concerns and suspected fraud follow the safeguarding policy and trustees' serious-incident process first, then this policy for the complainant's follow-up.

## 3. How to complain
Email info@rallygood.org.uk with the subject "Complaint", or write to **[ADDRESS]**. Tell us what happened, when, and what you would like us to do. You can complain anonymously, but we may then be unable to reply.

## 4. What happens next
| Step | Commitment **[trustees to confirm each timescale they can keep]** |
|---|---|
| Acknowledge | Within [5] working days |
| First review | By [NAME/ROLE, not the person complained about], within [20] working days; we will say if more time is needed and why |
| Reply | A written outcome and any action we will take |
| Appeal | Ask the [Chair / a trustee not involved] to review within [20] working days of the reply |

## 5. If you remain unhappy
- Fundraising complaints: you can contact the Fundraising Regulator after our process. **[Confirm current eligibility and contact details against their website.]**
- Concerns about the charity's governance or finances: the Charity Commission. **[Confirm current route.]**
- Data protection: the Information Commissioner's Office.

## 6. Records and learning
We keep a complaints log (date, summary, outcome, action, closed date) with no more personal data than necessary. Trustees review it **[quarterly]** and report themes in the annual report where appropriate.

## 7. Fairness
Complaints will be handled confidentially, taken seriously and without penalty to the complainant. Anyone complained about will be told and given a fair chance to respond.

## Adoption
Adopted by the trustees on **[DATE]**. Review date **[DATE]**. Owner **[ROLE]**.
